steps.message:
FILES: rich/panel.py:205-206
ROOT CAUSE: The `title_text` is only stylized with `partial_border_style` (the border style) before being aligned, but the `align_text` function creates a new `Text` object using `Text.assemble`, which loses the initial styling of the `title_text` unless it's explicitly handled. More importantly, the `style` of the `Panel` (which includes the background) should be applied to the title area to ensure it matches the panel background.

CHANGE: Change `title_text.stylize_before(partial_border_style)` to `title_text.stylize_before(style)` in `rich/panel.py` around line 206. This ensures the title inherits the panel's overall style (including background) before the border-specific styling is applied by `align_text`.

TEST: A reproduction script creating a `Panel` with a background style (`style="on blue"`) and a `title`, verifying that the title area also has the background style.

```python
from rich.panel import Panel
from rich.console import Console
console = Console(force_terminal=True)
console.print(Panel('Content', title='Title', style='on blue'))
```
